execution_rule: Do not run downstream implementation until preceding pass acceptance is evidenced; independent read-only reviews may proceed
policy: Preserve original lossless decoders and 16-bit/44.1kHz playback floor
Preserve 1KiB Pip-Boy panel and RBPK v1
No unexpected startup scan or autoplay
Do not commit private audio or paths

passes.title: Baseline and reproducibility
passes.scope: Pin current SHA; same-file CLI/GUI reproduction; resolve actual selected file and surface child failures
passes.acceptance: CLI audible versus GUI failure classified; commands and sanitized logs recorded

passes.title: Repair native GUI playback handoff
passes.scope: Add failing managed-process regression; fix proven select/queue/play/focus/IPC defect; preserve native decoder
passes.acceptance: Actual FLAC audible from Mac GUI; no false Playing; tests pass

passes.title: Truthful progress and state
passes.scope: Typed RBPK view parsing; elapsed/duration, output state, pause/end/error reset; safe accessibility labels
passes.acceptance: Counters advance and reset correctly, malformed IPC tests pass

passes.title: Winamp-layout skeleton
passes.scope: Compact persistent player; navigation sidebar; sortable/searchable track table; docked queue; adaptive resizing
passes.acceptance: Desktop layout screenshot checks at two window sizes; keyboard order validated

passes.title: Play and queue semantics
passes.scope: Double-click/Enter Play Now, multiselect, Play Next, Next/Previous playback, natural EOF exactly once
passes.acceptance: User journey tests, no overlapping sinks, operator audio confirmation

passes.title: Playlist editing and persistence
passes.scope: Queue reorder, Finder import, named playlists, safe M3U8, restart restoration without autoplay
passes.acceptance: Persistence, symlink/traversal, Unicode and media-byte preservation tests

passes.title: A/B acceptance
passes.scope: Same-file baseline/candidate, WAV/FLAC, route, queue UX, 2k/20k catalogs; raw latency and task metrics
passes.acceptance: Three functional repetitions, five UX pilots, observable acoustic evidence and failure rows

passes.title: Release evidence handoff
passes.scope: Update registry and logs with exact SHAs; run offline gate, macOS build/signature checks, mark remaining hardware blocks
passes.acceptance: No pass without reproduced evidence; reviewable commits and next-stage readiness report
